text.en:
Scoring opposing Elemental Alignment Kills grants 25% increased damage for #e${8.5+#d} seconds.

Buff can be activated while stowed.

Elemental Alignment details:
• <arc/>Arc, <solar/>Solar, <void/>Void Kills buff Kinetic, <stasis/>Stasis, and <strand/>Strand Weapons
• <stasis/>Stasis and <strand/>Strand Kills buff <arc/>Arc, <solar/>Solar, and <void/>Void Weapons

enhanced (
var d = 2
#e Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.
)
